docs.title: PythonNative
docs.text: Build native Android and iOS apps with Python. PythonNative provides a Pythonic API for native UI components and a simple CLI to scaffold and run projects.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: A collection of simple examples showing PythonNative components and patterns.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
pip install pythonnative
pn --help
  • Install: pip install pythonnative
  • Create a project: pn init my_app
  • Run: pn run android or pn run ios
